activity_summary: George Peele passed with a roll of paper. He said he has a poem on the tilt, and that every horse in it rhymes. He asked whether Titus still gets the laugh in the wrong place. You did not mend it for him. He asked a groat. You did not give it. You had already paid twelve pence at the gate. You stayed. He went on.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Refused the groat and stayed at the barrier.

entities.name: George Peele
entities.context: Offered the poem, asked after Titus, and went on with his paper.
